messages:
maya: heads up — saw a recon pattern after compacting ledgers: a few tenants show sparse credits (missing small token buckets) after the compaction job.
tom: can you paste a minimal repro or a sample event id?
maya: sample: event=e-77a, tenant=t-acme, compacted_seq=98432 — recon later found claim but no matching invoice line.
rachel: sounds like compaction dropped ephemeral soft-claims that never finalized. do we compact tombstones aggressively?
maya: compaction set ttl=3d for tombstones; some late-arrivals older than 72h were rehydrated by sidecar backfill and collided.
tom: two quick options: 1) increase tombstone TTL to 7d, or 2) make compact idempotent by preserving claimKey when tombstoning. 1 is operational, 2 is more durable.
ops-bot: compaction job config: tombstone_ttl=259200s (3d). queued patch to 604800s (7d) pending review.
finance-bot: any customer impact? estimate revenue delta?
maya: small — total delta <$50 across affected tenants. still need deterministic fix.
ci-bot: running unit/regression: compact-preserve-claimKey suite  started
ci-bot: compact-preserve-claimKey passed (all variants)
rachel: proposal: short-term bump TTL to 7d + backfill run for 30d window; long-term preserve claimKey on tombstone so recon dedupes reliably.
tom: agree. also add metric: tombstone_rewrites and recon-missing-claim alerts when >3 tenants in 1h.
audits-team: tag audits-team: any rewrite of historic claimKey requires backfill mapping signoff.
maya: action items:
- ops: bump tombstone TTL to 7d (in progress)
- tom: implement tombstone-preserve-claimKey patch and tests (48h)
- maya: schedule backfill for 30d window and dry-run report (this week)
- audits-team: review backfill mapping once PR posted
finance-bot: please include correction export (tenant,eventId,delta,reason) for customer visibility.
maya: will open RFC/PR and ping this thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
